summary: This is a single VivaCity camera (counter 319) at Wattle St and Kelly St, Ultimo, so no series need defining. Zone 475 (Wattle St NE shared path, NW of Kelly St) has intermittent phantom surges of hundreds to thousands of bikes a day in both directions that no neighbouring zone shows, and I set those days to missing. The step changes in Nov and Dec 2024 (476, 483, 477, 479) look like real new infrastructure and are kept, and the 479 footpath zeros during that work are restored as a likely closure.
